svg.aria-label: Below the surface: about 80% of last year’s contributions are private. Sealed files: a co-op game mod, an LCD handheld rebuild, a game launcher, a Quoridor game, a Telegram bug-tracker Mini App, a full-stack product, a desktop notes app, a Rust renderer.
